events.name: Houston Astros at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Joey Loperfido hit a tiebreaking home run in the 11th inning and the Houston Astros beat the Toronto Blue Jays 9-7 on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joey Loperfido hits tiebreaking 3-run HR in 11th inning as Astros beat Blue Jays 9-7

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Tampa Bay native Jac Caglianone continued his hot June by homering twice and driving in three runs in the Kansas City Royals' 12-5 victory over the reeling Rays on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jac Caglianone continues tear with 2 homers and 3 RBIs as the Royals beat the Rays 12-5

events.name: New York Yankees at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Jazz Chisholm Jr. homered, drove in two runs and scored twice and the New York Yankees beat the Detroit Tigers 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jazz Chisholm Jr.'s big night at the plate helps Yankees end 3-game skid with 4-3 win over Tigers

headlines.description: — Cole Young hit a two-run home run in the seventh inning in his first major league game in his hometown to lift the Seattle Mariners to a 3-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Young hits a two-run home run in the seventh to lift Mariners to a 3-2 victory over Pirates

headlines.description: — Sandy Alcantara set the franchise career record for strikeouts and won his fifth consecutive start in June, leading the Miami Marlins to a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alcantara sets Marlins' career strikeouts record in 6-4 win over Rangers

headlines.description: — Bryson Stott's three-run homer highlighted Philadelphia's eight-run outburst in the ninth inning and the Phillies rallied to beat the Washington Nationals 14-9 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies score 8 runs in the ninth inning and rally past the Nationals 14-9

events.name: Chicago Cubs at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Ben Brown and Edward Cabrera were placed on the injured list Wednesday, delivering two more blows for the pitching-depleted Chicago Cubs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs add 2 more pitchers to injured list with Ben Brown, Edward Cabrera

headlines.description: — Brandon Sproat pitched one-hit ball for six shutout innings and had a career-high 10 strikeouts, Hank Bauers and Andrew Vaughn drove in runs and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Cincinnati Reds 2-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sproat, Bauers and Vaughn power Brewers to a 2-0 win over the Reds

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox
Los Angeles Dodgers at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Freddie Freeman and Andy Pages each had three of the Dodgers’ season high-tying 17 hits, Justin Wrobleski worked seven strong innings, and Los Angeles beat the Minnesota Twins 12-3 Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers pound out a season high-tying 17 hits in 12-3 win over Twins

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Nolan Arenado and Lourdes Gurriel Jr. had run-scoring hits and Arizona's eventual winning run scored on a passed ball — all in the ninth inning — as the Diamondbacks beat the St. Louis Cardinals 4-3 Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arenado, Gurriel deliver RBI hits, D-back score winning run on passed ball in 4-3 win over Cards

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Wilyer Abreu and Nate Eaton drove in two runs each to back an 11-strikeout performance from Sonny Gray and the Boston Red Sox beat the Colorado Rockies 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox beat the Rockies 5-2 behind Sonny Gray’s 11 strikeouts

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Rookie right-hander Ryan Johnson gave up one hit over six scoreless innings, Nolan Schanuel hit an early two-run home run and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Baltimore Orioles 5-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Johnson dominates, Nolan Schanuel adds 2-run HR as Angels beat Orioles 5-1

events.name: Atlanta Braves at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Manny Machado hit an RBI single in the 10th inning to lead the San Diego Padres to a 7-6 walk-off win over the Atlanta Braves on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado hits a 10th-inning RBI single, lifting Padres past Braves 7-6

events.name: Athletics Athletics at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Robbie Ray held the Athletics to an unearned run and two hits in eight innings to lead the San Francisco Giants to a 3-1 victory Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robbie Ray limits Athletics to an unearned run and 2 hits in 8 innings as Giants win 3-1
